abilities.name: There For You
abilities.description: Once per round, as a Free Action, when an allied Tamer or Digimon within 4 spaces of you takes damage, you may spend Hope equal to your Sincerity rank to heal them for HP equal to your Sincerity rank.

abilities.name: Lighter Load
abilities.description: There For You's Hope cost changes from your Sincerity rank to a flat 4 Hope.

abilities.name: Wider Circle
abilities.description: There For You's range increases from 4 spaces to 8 spaces.

abilities.name: Softened Blow
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when an attack against you scores a Critical Hit, you may treat the damage as though it weren't a critical hit. All other effects tied to the crit still apply.

abilities.name: All at Once
abilities.description: When There For You triggers, it heals every allied Tamer and Digimon within range, including yourself, for your Sincerity rank, not just the ally who took the damage.

abilities.name: Never Really Gone
abilities.description: Even while defeated at 0 HP, or after submitting out of a fight against a Dark Digimon, you may still take one action each round, as long as it isn't an attack.
